$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this document. Studio ignores it.

name.description: The project name that the editor shows.

code.description: The Python script. Studio runs it after `loader.py`, which defines `datacube`, `reduced` and `add_graph_to_map`. Read `agents/script-contract.md`.

collectionId.description: The id of a collection of the openEO backend.

bands.description: The band ids of the collection, for example `reflectance|bands=b04`. The script reads `data[i]` in this order.

boundingBox.description: west, south, east, north in EPSG:4326 degrees. Longitudes are from -180 to 180, latitudes from -90 to 90, and south is not more than north.

cloudCover.description: The maximum cloud cover in percent (filter `eo:cloud_cover < cloudCover`). Without it, there is no cloud cover filter.

SampleBand.description: A band name of the collection, for example `B04` or `reflectance|bands=b04`.
